name: Employe Update Profile
script:
if doc.status == "Pending":
    frappe.throw("Status with Approved or Rejected can be submitted")

# If Rejected → No update should happen
if doc.status == "Rejected":
    frappe.msgprint("Request Rejected. No employee data will be updated.")
else:
    # Only run when status is Approved
    if doc.status == "Approved":
        emp = frappe.get_doc("Employee", doc.employee)

        field_map = {
            "cell_number": "new_mobile",
            "personal_email": "new_email",
            "person_to_be_contacted": "new_emergency_contact_name",
            "emergency_phone_number": "new_emergency_phone",
            "relation": "new_relation",
            "custom_pcity": "new_present_city",
            "custom_ppin": "new_present_pin",
            "custom_present_state": "new_present_state",
            "custom_present_street": "new_present_street",
            "custom_telph": "new_present_telephone_number",
            "current_address": "new_current_address",
            "current_accommodation_type": "new_current_address_is",
            "custom_pmtcity": "new_permanent_city",
            "custom_pmtpin": "new_permanent_pin",
            "custom_permanent_state": "new_permanent_state",
            "custom_permanent_street": "new_permanent_street",
            "permanent_address": "new_permanent_address",
            "permanent_accommodation_type": "new_permanent_address_is",
            "custom_permanent_telephone_number": "new_permanent_telephone_number"
      }

        for emp_field, req_field in field_map.items():
            value = doc.get(req_field)
            if value:
                emp.set(emp_field, value)

        emp.save(ignore_permissions=True)
        frappe.msgprint("Employee details updated..")

name: Position Mapping Script
Employee Benifit
script:
# Get PBM document name
pbm_name = frappe.db.get_value(
    "Position Benefit Mapping",
    {"designation": doc.designation, "grade": doc.grade},
    "name"
)

if pbm_name:
    # Load full PBM doc to get child table directly
    pbm_doc = frappe.get_doc("Position Benefit Mapping", pbm_name)

    # Clear employee table
    doc.custom_employee_benefit = []

    # Loop through child table rows exactly as they are
    for row in pbm_doc.position_benefit:
        doc.append("custom_employee_benefit", {
            "benefit_type": row.benefit_type,
            "amount": row.amount,
            "frequency": row.frequency
        })
